shortDescription: Import a role into a play

options.name: allow_duplicates
options.description: Overrides the role's metadata setting to allow using a role more than once with the same parameters.

options.name: defaults_from
options.description: File to load from a role's C(defaults/) directory.

options.name: handlers_from
options.description: File to load from a role's C(handlers/) directory.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the role to be executed.

options.name: public
options.description: This option dictates whether the role's C(vars) and C(defaults) are exposed to the play. Variables are exposed to the play at playbook parsing time, and available to earlier roles and tasks as well unlike C(include_role). The default depends on the configuration option R(DEFAULT_PRIVATE_ROLE_VARS, DEFAULT_PRIVATE_ROLE_VARS).

options.name: rolespec_validate
options.description: Perform role argument spec validation if an argument spec is defined.

options.name: tasks_from
options.description: File to load from a role's C(tasks/) directory.

options.name: vars_from
options.description: File to load from a role's C(vars/) directory.
